name: Texture Optimization for Volume Synthesis
definition: A method to synthesize a cloud volume V from a set of K voxel blocks Cex by minimizing an energy function that measures the distance between input image pixel blocks and rendered voxel blocks.
summary: Texture Optimization for Volume Synthesis synthesizes 3D cloud volumes from a single photograph by optimizing voxel values via an Expectation-Maximization framework, distinguishing itself by solving for volume geometry rather than just lighting.
